files.claim: the pinned AppBay tree installs and builds, so its CLI can be executed for evidence
files.proves: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile exits 1 with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE: the lockfile still lists @appbay/core as a dependency of packages/db, which packages/db/package.json no longer declares. release.yml:53 runs that exact command, so the tag-triggered release build fails the same way.

files.claim: with the lockfile refreshed the tree installs, builds and the CLI runs
files.proves: install and build both succeeded (3/3 turbo tasks); only the smoke check failed, because apps/cli builds a bun-compiled binary at dist/appbay and the script looked for dist/index.js. Superseded by action-03.

files.claim: with the lockfile refreshed the tree installs, builds and the CLI runs
files.proves: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile then turbo build: 3 of 3 packages built; dist/appbay --version prints 0.1.0-dev. The only barrier to executing AppBay from the snapshot is the stale lockfile.

files.claim: making derived paths investigation-relative preserves every artifact's bytes and hash
files.proves: 12 records had their derived-path prefix made investigation-relative; all 92 derived artifacts were then re-hashed against the sha256 and byte count their records claim, with 0 mismatches. WROTE went 0 -> 92 and IN_RUN 1 -> 6 in the projector, confirming the cause was the path prefix rather than missing artifacts.

files.claim: the work graph builds into LadybugDB and its counts reconcile against the records
files.proves: LadybugDB 0.20.4 refused the bulk COPY: 'The table ABOUT has multiple FROM and TO pairs defined in the schema.' The bridge pointed ABOUT at both Product and CodeSite; the projector's COPY does not name a pair. Import CSVs were written (227 nodes / 330 edges) but nothing loaded. Superseded by action-19 after making each bridge type single-label.

files.claim: the work graph builds into LadybugDB and its counts reconcile against the records
files.proves: With each bridge type pointing at one domain label, the graph loaded: 232 nodes / 333 edges and 'conformance: 27 counts reconciled against the CSVs'. dangling_edges.csv held only its header.

files.claim: with the run configs parseable, the graph rebuilds and every run carries its code version
files.proves: After quoting the run-config scalars (a data_epoch containing ': ' was invalid YAML and the projector swallowed the parse error), all 13 run configs parse under yq and the graph rebuilt at 238 nodes / 339 edges with 'conformance: 27 counts reconciled'. Every run now carries its code_version.

files.claim: the shipped CLI exposes fewer commands than it registers, and most reporting commands have no --json
files.proves: Procedure defect found on reread: grep -c 'json$' also matched 'no-json' (51+47=98 over 51 commands), and the declared-command list swept in subcommand names from every commands/*.ts file, so 'declared but not in help' listed secrets/edge/catalog subcommands. files.claim: measured over top-level commands only: the docs and --json gaps are smaller than the prior count but real
files.proves: 47 real top-level commands after subtracting 4 retirement notices (admin, auth, authelia, help) from the 51 names in --help. 46 have a heading in docs/reference/cli-commands.qmd; only exec and run do not. Only 4 of 47 accept --json: doctor, list, ps, status. The repo's own check-docs-cli.mjs exits 0 (51 commands, 28 docs files, 0 discrepancies).

files.claim: check-docs-cli.mjs goes red on drift it claims to catch, so its green result means something
files.proves: Three-way mutation test on the sandbox copy: baseline exit 0; a documented-but-absent command (appbay teleport) -> 2 discrepancies, exit 1; a documented-but-absent flag (appbay status --telepathy) -> 1 discrepancy, exit 1; restored -> exit 0. The checker is sensitive to both failure classes it claims to catch.

files.claim: AppBay's own tests pass at 9f00b579 with its uncommitted changes
files.proves: pnpm turbo test at the pinned tree: 5/5 tasks successful, @appbay/core 85 files / 1148 passed + 1 skipped, @appbay/cli 29 files / 403 passed. Zero failures \u2014 while probe-05 shows live silent data loss, so the suite is green and the defect is real.

files.claim: an edited decision survives rebuilding while generated columns refresh from the records
files.proves: G6.decision was hand-edited to 'leave' and G1.blast_radius clobbered; after rebuild G6.decision is still 'leave' (human state read back and merged) and G1.blast_radius is restored from its record. audit_decision grew 10 -> 12 with no row updated or deleted. The seeded decision was then restored through a further append.
